intents.label: What is ZoikoVertex
intents.answer_first: ZoikoVertex is an enterprise SaaS platform for governed AI-assisted marketing and social media execution. It helps businesses, agencies, and multi-brand teams manage campaign workflows, content approvals, publishing controls, user permissions, audit trails, evidence records, AI agent oversight, and enterprise governance in one secure workspace. Are you evaluating ZoikoVertex for a business, an agency, or an enterprise team?

intents.label: Governed Agentic Execution
intents.answer_first: Governed Agentic Execution™ is the core ZoikoVertex doctrine. It means AI agents operate within defined authority boundaries — they do not publish, approve, or act autonomously. Every action taken by an AI agent in ZoikoVertex is governed by the Authority Layer Doctrine, subject to the Three-Key Approval Protocol, and preserved in the Evidence Vault for auditability.

intents.label: Pricing
trigger_signals: which plan is right for me
intents.answer_first:
ZoikoVertex offers four plans:

1. Vertex Starter (Free) – 2 users, 2 channels, 1 brand, 30-day history. Command Center (limited), analytics snapshot, AI recommendations (read-only), basic activity log, email support. Best for exploring the platform.

2. Vertex Growth ($399/mo or $299/mo annual) – 7 users, 8 profiles, 1 brand, 12mo history. Content Studio, 5 AI agents, Review Queue, two-step approvals, immutable audit trail, Basic Brand Library, priority support. Best for teams ready to run governed campaigns.

3. Vertex Scale ($999/mo or $799/mo annual) – 20 users, 25 profiles, up to 5 brands, 24mo history. Advanced AI agents, multi-stage approvals, full Brand Library, Crisis Console, cross-brand analytics, named CSM. Best for multi-brand teams and agencies.

4. Vertex Corporate (Custom) – Custom users, profiles, and brands. Three-key approval protocol, Evidence Vault, legal hold, SSO/SAML/SCIM, DPA, dedicated TAM + AE. Best for enterprise and regulated industries.

For a full breakdown, visit https://zoikovertex.com/pricing

intents.label: Evidence Vault
trigger_signals: what does the evidence vault do
intents.answer_first: The Evidence Vault is ZoikoVertex's immutable evidence record module. It captures and preserves a tamper-resistant record of campaign content, approvals, decisions, and publishing events. It is designed to support audit, legal review, and regulatory enquiry. Evidence Vault records cannot be deleted by standard platform users — access is governed by the Compliance Officer and Auditor profiles.

intents.label: Three-Key Approval Protocol
trigger_signals: what is the three key approval protocol
intents.answer_first: The Three-Key Approval Protocol is the locked campaign release mechanism. Key One is held by the Approval Authority — this is the operational approval confirming the campaign is content-complete and operationally ready. Key Two is held by the Legal Reviewer or Compliance Reviewer — this is the governance approval confirming the campaign meets legal, regulatory, and brand compliance requirements. Key Three is held by the Executive Approver — this is the final release gate. All three keys must be granted before a campaign can proceed to the Publishing Hub. No single key holder can override the protocol.

intents.label: Can AI publish automatically
intents.answer_first: No AI in ZoikoVertex publishes without authorised human approval. Publishing requires all three keys of the Three-Key Approval Protocol to be granted by the Approval Authority, the Legal or Compliance Reviewer, and the Executive Approver respectively. AI operates within the boundaries set by the Authority Layer Doctrine.

intents.label: Policy Control Matrix
trigger_signals: what is the policy control matrix
intents.answer_first: The Policy Control Matrix enforces content restrictions, approval routing, and governance policies across the workspace. It is part of the Authority Layer Doctrine and is configured by the Compliance Officer and Brand Steward roles. The matrix defines who can create what content, who must approve it, and under what conditions it can be published.

intents.label: Brand Library
intents.answer_first: The Brand Library is ZoikoVertex's central repository for brand guidelines, approved language, visual assets, content standards, and brand voice configuration. It is managed by the Brand Steward role and ensures all content created in the platform adheres to brand standards before entering the approval queue.

intents.label: Data Export
intents.answer_first: Yes. ZoikoVertex supports data export for workspace data including campaign records, Evidence Vault content, analytics reports, and audit trail data. Export capabilities depend on your plan. Contact Support for assistance with specific data export requirements.

intents.label: Segregation of Duties
intents.answer_first: Segregation of Duties (SoD) is a core governance principle in ZoikoVertex. It ensures no single individual can control all stages of the campaign lifecycle. The Three-Key Approval Protocol enforces SoD by requiring three different authorised roles to approve before publishing. Vertex Scale and Corporate include advanced SoD enforcement with configurable approval matrices.

intents.label: Campaign Workflows Detail
intents.answer_first: Campaign Workflows in ZoikoVertex manage the complete campaign lifecycle from brief through launch gate to reconciled evidence. The typical workflow includes: 1) Campaign brief and planning in the Content Calendar, 2) Content creation and asset upload to the Media Vault, 3) Pre-publishing validation through the Validation Desk, 4) Approval routing through the Three-Key Approval Protocol, 5) Publishing via the Publishing Hub to connected channels, 6) Post-publishing evidence capture in the Evidence Vault, 7) Performance analysis through analytics and reporting.

intents.label: How ZoikoVertex is Different
intents.answer_first: ZoikoVertex is fundamentally different from traditional social media management platforms. ZoikoVertex is built on Governed Agentic Execution™ — AI agents operate within defined authority boundaries and never publish without authorised human approval. Key differentiators include: the Three-Key Approval Protocol for locked campaign release, the Evidence Vault for immutable audit trails, the Authority Layer Doctrine for AI governance, Segregation of Duties enforcement, and workspace isolation for multi-tenant security. ZoikoVertex is not just a publishing tool — it is a governance-first execution platform for accountable marketing operations.

intents.label: Campaign Command Center Correction
intents.answer_first: That name is not an official ZoikoVertex module. The campaign management surface is called Campaign Workflows. Campaign Workflows manage the process from brief through launch gate to reconciled evidence.

faq.a: ZoikoVertex is an enterprise SaaS platform for governed AI-assisted marketing and social media execution. It helps businesses, agencies, and multi-brand teams manage campaign workflows, content approvals, publishing controls, user permissions, audit trails, evidence records, AI agent oversight, and enterprise governance in one secure workspace. Are you evaluating ZoikoVertex for a business, an agency, or an enterprise team?

Governed Agentic Execution™ is the core ZoikoVertex doctrine. It means AI agents operate within defined authority boundaries — they do not publish, approve, or act autonomously. Every action taken by an AI agent in ZoikoVertex is governed by the Authority Layer Doctrine, subject to the Three-Key Approval Protocol, and preserved in the Evidence Vault for auditability.

No. ZoikoVertex supports governance, review workflows, evidence records, auditability, and controlled execution — but customers remain responsible for their own legal, regulatory, advertising, privacy, and industry obligations. ZoikoVertex does not provide legal advice and does not guarantee regulatory compliance on your behalf.

No AI in ZoikoVertex publishes without authorised human approval. Publishing requires all three keys of the Three-Key Approval Protocol to be granted by the Approval Authority, the Legal or Compliance Reviewer, and the Executive Approver respectively. AI operates within the boundaries set by the Authority Layer Doctrine.

faq.q: Can I bypass the approval workflow?
faq.a: No. ZoikoVertex is designed to preserve governance integrity. The Three-Key Approval Protocol and publishing controls exist to protect your organisation's compliance position and accountability record. I cannot help you bypass these controls. If a workflow is blocked, the correct path is to follow the approval process or contact your Workspace Administrator.

faq.q: What does the Evidence Vault do?
faq.a: The Evidence Vault is ZoikoVertex's immutable evidence record module. It captures and preserves a tamper-resistant record of campaign content, approvals, decisions, and publishing events. It is designed to support audit, legal review, and regulatory enquiry. Evidence Vault records cannot be deleted by standard platform users — access is governed by the Compliance Officer and Auditor profiles.

faq.q: How does the Three-Key Approval Protocol work?
faq.a: The Three-Key Approval Protocol is the locked campaign release mechanism. Key One is held by the Approval Authority — the operational approval confirming the campaign is content-complete and operationally ready. Key Two is held by the Legal Reviewer or Compliance Reviewer — the governance approval confirming the campaign meets legal, regulatory, and brand compliance requirements. Key Three is held by the Executive Approver — the final release gate. All three keys must be granted before a campaign can proceed to the Publishing Hub. No single key holder can override the protocol.

faq.q: Who holds Key One in the approval protocol?
faq.a: Key One is held by the Approval Authority. This is the operational approval — confirming the campaign is content-complete and operationally ready.

faq.q: Who holds Key Two in the approval protocol?
faq.a: Key Two is held by the Legal Reviewer or Compliance Reviewer. This is the governance approval — confirming the campaign meets legal, regulatory, and brand compliance requirements.

faq.q: Who holds Key Three in the approval protocol?
faq.a: Key Three is held by the Executive Approver. This is the final release gate — the authorised final sign-off before publishing is unlocked.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Audit Trail and the Evidence Vault?
faq.a: The Evidence Vault is ZoikoVertex's immutable evidence record module — it captures and preserves a tamper-resistant record of campaign content, approvals, decisions, and publishing events. The Audit Trail provides a chronological record of platform events, policy changes, and user actions. Both support auditability but serve different purposes: the Evidence Vault preserves campaign-specific evidence, while the Audit Trail tracks platform-wide activity.

ZoikoVertex's Responsible AI framework covers oversight design and Authority Layer Doctrine governance. AI operates within defined boundaries — no AI publishes without authorised human approval. Every AI agent action is governed by the Authority Layer Doctrine, subject to the Three-Key Approval Protocol, and preserved in the Evidence Vault for auditability.

faq.q: How does ZoikoVertex handle restricted content?

Agent Studio enables configuration of AI agents within defined governance boundaries and approval requirements. All agents operate under the Authority Layer Doctrine.

faq.q: What is the Authority Layer Doctrine?
faq.a: The Authority Layer Doctrine is the platform's governing layer over AI agent permissions and publishing authority. Every AI agent action runs through runtime checks that verify identity, permissions, policy, and evidence before an agent acts. No AI publishes without authorised human approval.
The Forensic Hub provides advanced investigation tools for reviewing platform activity and policy events. Access is governed by the Compliance Officer and Auditor profiles.
The Identity Ledger records identity and access events for auditability and compliance review. Access is governed by the Compliance Officer and Auditor profiles.

ZoikoVertex supports governance workflows that help organisations meet their compliance obligations, but customers remain responsible for their own GDPR and regulatory compliance. Privacy and data handling practices are detailed in the Privacy Policy and Data Processing Addendum.

The Three-Key Approval Protocol requires all three keys to be held by authorised individuals.
